brief: JPM's morning briefing holds a tactically cautious to neutral stance on global equities. Asia is mixed and US and EU futures are lower: calls for tighter AI oversight, led by Amodei's essay urging the industry to slow frontier development, weigh on Tech, while Saudi Arabia's suspension of the East-West pipeline after drone attacks lifts oil, potentially by up to $20/bbl if operations do not restart within days. USDJPY has stabilised after a material positioning reset. Ahead of Fed, BoE and BoJ meetings, Kasman says the DM hiking cycle is broadening and the Taylor rule points to DM policy rates roughly 100bp higher. JPM still does not expect a material slowdown in AI infrastructure earnings, because adoption and token trends are intact and the administration stays pro-AI. Regional preference stays long US and Asia versus EU, with cheap index hedges added, supercycle-theme longs hedged via momentum options, high-conviction shorts in EU chemicals and Asian consumer electronics, and gold profit taken with intent to re-enter. JPM is bullish EM via China H-shares, KWEB and Taiwan. Positioning is neutral top-down, but US equity ETF flows sit at -2z and CTAs are long crude and short bonds at macro extremes.
